```{r load-packages}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.core)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r simulate-data}
#### Simulate Vitals Data with Duplicates ####
set.seed(42)

n_subj <- 60
n_visits <- 10
subjects <- paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_subj))
sites <- paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", rep(1:6, each = 10)))

Mapped_SUBJ <- data.frame(
  subjid = subjects,
  invid = sites,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Generate VS data
vs_rows <- expand.grid(subjid = subjects, visit = 1:n_visits, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vs_rows$vs_dt <- as.Date("2024-01-01") + (vs_rows$visit - 1) * 30
vs_rows$weight <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 75, 10), 1)
vs_rows$sysbp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 125, 15), 0)
vs_rows$diabp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 80, 10), 0)

# Inject ~10% duplicates per measure
inject_duplicates <- function(values, subjects, rate = 0.10) {
  for (subj in unique(subjects)) {
    idx <- which(subjects == subj)
    if (length(idx) <= 1) next
    n_dup <- max(1, round(length(idx[-1]) * rate))
    dup_pos <- sample(idx[-1], n_dup)
    for (p in dup_pos) {
      prior <- idx[idx < p]
      values[p] <- values[sample(prior, 1)]
    }
  }
  values
}

vs_rows$weight <- inject_duplicates(vs_rows$weight, vs_rows$subjid)
vs_rows$sysbp <- inject_duplicates(vs_rows$sysbp, vs_rows$subjid)
vs_rows$diabp <- inject_duplicates(vs_rows$diabp, vs_rows$subjid)

Mapped_VS <- vs_rows[, c("subjid", "vs_dt", "weight", "sysbp", "diabp")]
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
#### Generate Record Duplication Report ####
w <- Report_RecordDuplication(
  dfMappedVS = Mapped_VS,
  dfMappedSUBJ = Mapped_SUBJ,
  vMeasuresVS = c("weight", "sysbp", "diabp"),
  dfReportingResults = gsm.core::reportingResults,
  dfReportingMetrics = gsm.core::reportingMetrics,
  strGroupLevel = "Site"
)
w
```
